entries.speaker: Rental Shop Worker
entries.en: Would you like to apply for our annual[n]membership? If you're a student, it's[n]4,800 yen during our campaign!

entries.speaker: Rental Shop Worker
entries.en: Rent all the old DVDs you want with no[n]extension fee! You can only rent one[n]at a time, though.
entries.uk: Беріть скільки завгодно старих DVD[n]без плати за продовження! Щоправда,[n]лише по одному за раз.

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: We're pretty busy, so not having to[n]worry about extension fees is awesome!

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: If you have the money, maybe you[n]should sign up?

entries.en: Sign me up.
